chunks.arabic_text: وَ كَتَبَ سَهْلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ الْأَدَمِيُّ إِلَى أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ:

translations.en: Sahl ibn Ziyad al-Adami wrote to Abu Muhammad عليه السلام:

chunks.arabic_text: رَجُلٌ لَهُ وُلْدٌ ذُكُورٌ وَ إِنَاثٌ فَأَقَرَّ بِضَيْعَةٍ أَنَّهَا لِوُلْدِهِ وَ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ أَنَّهَا بَيْنَهُمْ عَلَى سِهَامِ اللَّهِ وَ فَرَائِضِهِ الذَّكَرُ وَ الْأُنْثَى فِي هِ سَوَاءٌ

translations.en: A man had male and female children, and he acknowledged that a piece of land belonged to his children, but he did not mention whether it was to be divided among them according to the shares of Allah and His prescribed obligations; the male and the female being equal in it.

chunks.arabic_text: فَوَقَّعَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ «يُنْفِذُونَ وَصِيَّةَ أَبِيهِمْ عَلَى مَا سَمَّى فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ سَمَّى شَيْئاً رَدُّوهَا عَلَى كِتَابِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ».

translations.en: So he عليه السلام wrote: "They are to carry out their father's bequest according to what he specified. But if he did not specify anything, they should refer it back to the Book of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, if Allah wills."

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a father's acknowledgment of property for his children when he does not clearly specify how it is to be distributed. If he explicitly designated its arrangement, his bequest is to be carried out as stated; if he left it unspecified, the matter returns to the inheritance rules in the Book of Allah.
en.seo_question: If a father assigns property to his children without specifying the shares, should it be divided equally or according to Islamic inheritance law?

key_terms.سِهَامِ اللَّهِ: the divinely assigned shares of inheritance
key_terms.فَرَائِضِهِ: His prescribed legal obligations, especially inheritance portions
key_terms.كِتَابِ اللَّهِ: the Book of Allah, meaning the Qur'anic legal standard
